title: CGT-G5 Preregistration — Native CGT Representation and Training
status: PREREGISTERED (gates locked before any G5 measurement)

frozen_upstream.corrected_teacher: px/py bug fixed; all affected experiments rerun
frozen_upstream.G2_certificate: dense + rigorous interval completed; safe fraction NOT 100% -> canonical fallback required
frozen_upstream.note: These are FORWARD-rendering results. They are NOT training-speed results and MUST NOT be counted as G5 training speed (goal §25, §28).

core_question: Can CGT stop being a post-hoc compressed student of 3D Gaussians and become a directly trainable scene representation whose native GPU renderer produces a meaningful real end-to-end reconstruction acceleration without sacrificing quality?

success_criterion_update.rationale: F0 ~3x is a forward-rendering result (goal §2). G5 is judged by end-to-end time-to-quality, final quality, robustness, VRAM, representation size, engineering overhead, training stability.
success_criterion_update.strong_practical_target: stable real training acceleration ~1.5x-2.0x with preserved quality
success_criterion_update.optimize_for: a decisive scientific answer, NOT activity or a headline multiplier (goal §1, §33)

quality_gates_frozen.relative_to: paired strong canonical baseline (same cohort/split/GT/eval cams, goal §3, §11)
quality_gates_frozen.LPIPS: reported if the existing baseline supports it; PSNR/SSIM remain HARD gates

certificate_differentiation_semantics.policy: The rigorous certificate/fallback decision MAY be non-differentiable. Do NOT silently backprop through discrete safe/fallback decisions (goal §9).
allowed_options: A: stop-gradient through certificate; differentiate the selected rendering branch
B: use canonical-branch gradient for fallback work
C: another mathematically justified piecewise treatment
certificate_differentiation_semantics.chosen_for_g5: A (stop-gradient on the per-tile safe label; differentiate the branch actually rendered: student if safe, canonical teacher if fallback). Documented per stage; no soft learned certificate unless separately preregistered.

stages.name: clean/exclusive F0 confirmation
stages.fail_condition: clean re-run collapses to pooled <=1x or correctness outside frozen tolerance

stages.name: native representation capacity oracle
stages.gate: direct native optimization reaches teacher-CGT envelope: |dPSNR|<=0.15 dB AND |dSSIM|<=0.005 vs teacher-fitted CGT

stages.name: gradient correctness
stages.gate: global gradient cosine >=0.999 AND relative L2 <=1e-3 AND no unexplained NaN/Inf

stages.name: controlled native optimization (room, fixed topology)
stages.gate: quality gate PASS AND (>=1.25x time-to-quality OR >=1.25x total controlled-training speedup OR comparable resource improvement with no time regression)

stages.name: real native training prototype (room -> garden -> bicycle)
stages.gate_room: quality PASS + no catastrophic instability + measured TTQ/speedup >=1.25x on room
stages.sequence: room first; do NOT launch all three before room validates

stages.name: structural/topology adaptation
stages.only_if: G5-D room passes but fixed native structure limits final quality
stages.note: minimum mechanism only; diagnose representation failure first; do NOT assume canonical 3DGS densification is appropriate

time_to_quality_metric.primary: S_TTQ = T_baseline(Q) / T_native(Q) for target quality Q (goal §15)

multi_scene_rule.bicycle_focus: F0 bicycle ~1.54x is well below room/garden; G5 must investigate its cause (safe fraction, high-freq detail, occlusion, tile workload, fallback, native-optimization difficulty, or structural) and not average it away (goal §21)

clean_timing_requirements: contaminated runs are INVALID not scientific failures (goal §23)
baseline_discipline: Use the current strong canonical baseline; record exact baseline commit/scene/checkpoint-init/renderer/loss/optimizer/CUDA-PyTorch-gsplat versions/tile settings/GPU (goal §26). Do NOT compare against an intentionally slow reference.
fail_closed_prohibitions: tune rank per scene post hoc
use teacher loss secretly in native candidate
count F0 forward speed as G5 training speed
rescue failed G5 with a large new representation change inside the same lane
rank_policy: Rank frozen upstream (R=4 primary). No adaptive-rank rescue by default; adaptive rank is a separate future lane unless explicitly opened after the frozen verdict (goal §19).
unreached_stage_policy: If a downstream stage is not reached, record NOT_REACHED. Do not fabricate measurements (goal §29).
final_threshold_note: PASS_NATIVE_CGT_METHOD_CANDIDATE: all quality gates pass, native genuinely trained directly, paired multi-scene evidence exists, real TTQ benefit meaningful, speedup robust. Strong practical target >=1.5x multi-scene TTQ. >=1.25x may qualify if quality preserved, memory favorable, clean, consistent, other structural benefits. PASS_NATIVE_CGT_STRONG_CANDIDATE reserved for ~>=2x real training accel + robust multi-scene + preserved quality + reasonable VRAM + clean native representation. Do NOT require 3x (goal §31).
